init_distrib_slurm: initialize torch distributed process group using SLURM or torch.distributed.launch environment variables with NCCL backend
rank0_only: use as a decorator or conditional check to restrict function execution to only world rank 0 processes
save_resume_state: save training resume state to a checkpoint file for preemptable SLURM job recovery
load_resume_state: load previously saved resume state from a checkpoint file for continuing preempted SLURM jobs
add_signal_handlers: register signal handlers for SIGINT SIGTERM SIGUSR1 and SIGUSR2 to manage clean exit and job requeue
